name: post-tool-use-todowrite-partial
description: The negative half of 10: the same TodoWrite call with one todo still `in_progress` maps to the identical ToolEvent with NO boundary. A partial update closes nothing, and `todosAllComplete` is strict on purpose — every todo must be `completed` (a `cancelled` todo means the work was dropped, not finished). Without this case, a mapper that flagged every TodoWrite would still look green.
